## Primary Open-Source Engineering Repositories

### 1. Sepotify
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/Sepotify
- Primary Language: Kotlin
- Platform: Android SDK
- Summary: Native, zero-delay local and offline audio playback engine engineered for lossless FLAC streaming with minimal memory overhead and battery optimization.

### 2. RuView
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/RuView
- Primary Language: Rust
- Platform: RF Sensing & Edge Nodes
- Summary: Contactless spatial intelligence and vital sign monitoring system utilizing commodity Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) signals without optical cameras.

### 3. ESP32-Deauth
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/ESP32-Deauth
- Primary Language: C++
- Platform: Espressif ESP32
- Summary: Standalone embedded firmware for ESP32 microcontrollers performing 802.11 management frame inspection, packet dissection, and wireless network security resilience testing.

### 4. RMN_Player
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/RMN_Player
- Primary Languages: Lua, GLSL, PowerShell
- Platform: Windows 10/11
- Summary: High-performance custom media player featuring real-time color-adaptive organic 2D diffused ambilight glow, native 10-bit libplacebo debanding tuned for OLED displays, bilingual EN/FA keyboard shortcuts, smart episodic series tracking, and title advertising sanitizer. Featured in awesome-mpv.

### 5. Drawsiness-detection
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/Drawsiness-detection
- Primary Language: Python
- Platform: Computer Vision & Edge Systems
- Summary: Real-time driver fatigue and drowsiness monitoring system utilizing 68-point facial landmarks and ocular blink duration analysis to prevent vehicle collisions.

### 6. sess-shirazu-autologin
- Repository: https://github.com/RMNO21/sess-shirazu-autologin
- Primary Language: JavaScript
- Platform: Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
- Summary: High-speed browser extension automating portal authentication with intelligent CAPTCHA detection and auto-reset mechanisms.
